svg.title: What Buff Your Money does
svg.desc: Quick entry by chat: A deterministic parser reads amounts, dates and context from a short sentence and files the transaction. Budgets and goals: Monthly budgets, savings goals and a safe-to-spend figure until the next payday. Debts and zakat: Plan how to pay off debts, and calculate zakat from your own records. Tax asset list: Gather the assets and income figures needed for an annual tax return in one list. Financial independence: Simulate financial independence targets, including a Monte Carlo run on your own numbers. Statement import: Import bank statements from PDF and spreadsheet files, plus portfolio files, instead of typing them. Family members: Invite family members into a shared book, each with their own login. Undoable agent actions: Every action by the agent is logged, and the user can undo recent ones.
svg.text: The parts of Buff Your Money people use every day.
